_rule: No song repeats within 10 consecutive reels (2-week window). pick_track.py selects the least-recently-used track for the requested mood. Usage is appended by the picker and committed with each reel.

_sources.motionarray: User's paid Motion Array sub — 30 tracks (ma-<mood>-NN.mp3) downloaded manually to Drive 'Gary Budgets > Reel Music'. NEVER automate downloads (ToS).
_sources.jamendo: Free Jamendo API client_id (user registers at api.jamendo.com — sheet 'Gary Budgets — TikTok & Music Launch Checklist' step 3). CC-BY tracks need caption credit.
